description: This file defines the custom exception class 'PatientIdentifierTypeLockedException' used within the OpenMRS API to indicate that patient identifier types are locked and cannot be manipulated.

classes.name: PatientIdentifierTypeLockedException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending APIException, thrown when patient identifier types are locked and cannot be changed.

methods.name: PatientIdentifierTypeLockedException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard message indicating that patient identifier types are locked.

methods.name: PatientIdentifierTypeLockedException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor allowing a custom message to be set explaining why the exception was thrown.

methods.name: PatientIdentifierTypeLockedException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor allowing a custom message and a cause (parent exception) to be chained.

methods.name: PatientIdentifierTypeLockedException(Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor allowing only the cause (parent exception) to be specified.
